inventory.anchor: import of the map; the context data of the menu
inventory.notes: A context menu opens at the real screen point: the coordinates the content process sent (declared) go through StealthContextScreenToReal. inventory.anchor: nsWindow::MakeFullScreen (the branch for an X11 display whose window manager does not support fullscreen, before NS_ERROR_NOT_AVAILABLE)
inventory.notes: Guard in the branch where Mozilla refuses fullscreen for lack of a window manager: StealthMakeFullScreenWithoutWM resizes the X window to the declared screen and answers true, as Windows and the headless widget decide fullscreen themselves. With the engine off, or on a kiosk monitor, it answers false and Mozilla's return runs.
